about: Sean C. Domnick is a distinguished civil trial lawyer whose experience and dedication have made him a prominent figure in the legal community. A shareholder at Rafferty Domnick Cunningham & Yaffa, based in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, his practice is exclusively focused on trial work related to personal injury law, majorly cases that often involve catastrophic injuries. Mr. Domnick's legal journey began at the University of Florida, where he earned a Bachelor of Science in 1986 followed by a Juris Doctor in 1989. Demonstrating a strong foundation in legal education, he passed The Florida Bar exam in 1990, setting the stage for a career marked by success and recognition.

With bar admissions including the U.S. Supreme Court, the U.S. District Courts for the Middle and Southern Districts of Florida and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit, Mr. Domnick has showcased his legal prowess across various jurisdictions. His board certifications as a Civil Trial Lawyer by The Florida Bar Board of Legal Specialization and Education as well as a Civil Trial Advocate by the National Board of Trial Advocacy underscore his in-depth knowledge and skills in trial law.

Over the years, Mr. Domnick has secured multimillion-dollar verdicts for his clients nationwide. His remarkable track record includes a $20 million jury verdict in a landmark case, in which cervical cancer was misdiagnosed due to a laboratory's failure to accurately interpret pap smear results.

These outstanding achievements have earned Mr. Domnick prestigious accolades such as the Top 1 ranking in the Jury Verdict Roundup for "Top Medical Malpractice Verdicts of 2014" and induction into the Daily Business Review's "Verdicts Hall of Fame" in 2015. Furthermore, his ethical professionalism was recognized with the B.J. Masterson Award by the Florida Justice Association in the same year and an inclusion in The Best Lawyers in America.

Beyond his courtroom victories, Mr. Domnick is the former president of the American Association for Justice, and he has also held leadership roles in the Palm Beach County Justice Association and the Miami-Dade Trial Lawyers Association. He is rated “Superb” on Avvo and has been peer-review rated AV Preeminent* through Martindale-Hubbell.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
